review_response_tasks.stem: Here is some ____ for your tea. It is white and you can drink it.
review_response_tasks.rationale: A：apples为复数，与is、it不一致，也非饮品。；B：milk不可数，符合some、is、it及可饮用白色液体。；C：biscuits复数且不是可喝的液体。

review_response_tasks.stem: The music lesson starts now. It's time ____ sing.
review_response_tasks.rationale: A：time to接动词原形sing。；B：time in sing不成结构。；C：for后不直接接该动词原形。

review_response_tasks.stem: —How many ____ are there? —Five drums beside the piano.
review_response_tasks.rationale: A：many要求复数，不能用单数。；B：回答明确是drums，不是balls。；C：复数drums与many和Five drums一致。

review_response_tasks.stem: We draw ____ seven ____ the morning ____ Saturdays.
review_response_tasks.rationale: A：一般时段morning需in，星期需on。；B：at seven、in the morning、on Saturdays正确。；C：钟点不用in，星期不用at。

review_response_tasks.stem: Amy has new socks. Look at ____ socks! ____ green.
review_response_tasks.rationale: A：Amy用her修饰，socks复数用They are。；B：socks前不用主格she作物主限定。；C：socks复数，不能用It is。

review_response_tasks.stem: This cup has only clean brushes, not dirty ones. Take a ____ brush, not a ____ one.
review_response_tasks.rationale: A：把允许拿的干净笔与不拿的脏笔反过来。；B：第一空与only clean冲突。；C：与干净笔可拿、脏笔不拿的要求一致。

review_response_tasks.stem: My aunt is in the music room. —____ your ____ there? —Yes, she is.
review_response_tasks.rationale: A：aunt单数不与Are搭配。；B：aunt单数用Is，she回答一致。；C：uncles复数并且不对应she。

review_response_tasks.stem: —Our kite broke before the show. We feel sad. —____
review_response_tasks.rationale: A：对风筝坏掉及难过直接表示同情。；B：祝贺不适合这条坏消息。；C：没有感谢，不用不用谢回应。

review_response_tasks.stem: We both lost our homework and need to find it. We are in the same boat. Here, “in the same boat” means ____.
review_response_tasks.rationale: A：题面在谈同样丢了作业，没有乘船。；B：与both lost our homework的共同困境不符。；C：两人同样丢了作业，支持共同困境的比喻。
